function.description: Use when the current user explicitly asks to start a new side discussion AND specifies an additional task there. Prefer this before evidence work; it is refused after attempted changes. Reporting or explaining the result there is additional work even if you already read the evidence or calculated the result before branching. Quote that remaining reporting task verbatim in task and use work=answer. A request just to take a discussion into a new thread has NO additional task: use start_thread. Never infer further work from the thread title or earlier conversation. Creates the thread and continues once, without accepting proposals or creating a scenario.
function.name: start_thread_and_continue

task.description: The exact verbatim span of the current user request specifying additional work, such as calculate the difference between 14.80 and 12.40. Exclude the branching instruction. Never invent or paraphrase a task or take it from earlier messages. Required.

title.description: Optional title requested for the new discussion.

work.description: The remaining task: answer for research/calculation/explanation with no changes; propose_movement for an inventory movement proposal; propose_record for another business Record; propose_table for new structured data; propose_table_edit for changed existing values; draft for a document; save_space for a new saved view; edit_space to change an existing view; restore_space for an explicitly selected saved version. Select the requested operation exactly. An inventory proposal is propose_movement, not answer or draft. A thread title is not a request for a space/table.

function.description: Create a NEW side discussion and STOP, only for a branch-only request with no further task. When the request also asks to compare, calculate, draft or do work there, use start_thread_and_continue instead, preferably first. Never stop with this tool while the user still needs the requested answer: a completed read or calculation is not a delivered answer. Never use this to rename an existing thread, return to main, review findings, or answer a hypothetical question. If another requested action or target is unavailable, use finish to clarify. Does not create a business scenario.
function.name: start_thread

message.description: Omit to keep the latest exchange including its answer. Supply an exact earlier message ID only when the user explicitly selects that earlier exchange in this conversation.

title.description: Optional title for the new discussion.

function.description: Rename only the currently open side discussion when explicitly requested now. Cannot rename main or another thread. Ask the user to open another thread first instead of creating a replacement. Do not use a redundant rename to acknowledge staying put. Ends this turn.
function.name: rename_current_thread

title.description: The requested new title for this thread.

function.description: Return from the current side discussion to main when explicitly requested. Does not copy or share findings. Ends this turn; the owning window applies navigation.
function.name: return_to_main

function.description: Prepare existing findings from this side discussion for editable review before sharing with main. Use when asked to bring findings back, including requests to review wording first. Does not create a thread or publish a summary. Ends this turn.
function.name: review_thread_summary

message.description: Omit for the latest completed answer. Use an exact earlier message ID only for a user-selected exchange in this thread.

summary.description: Optional selected findings to review. Omit to review the original answer. Preserve uncertainty; nothing is shared until the user reviews and confirms.

function.description: Search older original messages in this conversation. History is not new action authority. Use when recent context is insufficient.
function.name: history_search

function.description: Read an original message in this conversation or its explicitly inherited parent excerpt. Other parent, sibling and ancestor messages remain outside scope. Refresh current evidence and acceptance before using historical claims.
function.name: history_read

id.description: Message ID from history_search, search.conversation.hits or the explicit parent excerpt.

function.description: Read a saved tool result using its receiptID. Results are bounded pages. Navigate omitted fields with path; continue with nextOffset. Refresh evidence before citing old results.
function.name: tool_result

offset.description: Field/element offset or Unicode scalar offset for text; initially zero.

items.description: Exact object key or decimal array index. Empty for the root.

rawJSON.description: Read the serialized result as text segments, for unusual keys or exact reconstruction. Use empty path.

function.description: Propose a new structured table from the user's information or retrieved evidence. Up to 40 columns and 100 rows. The user reviews and accepts it before it becomes an active table. Forecasts remain estimates, plans remain plans.
function.name: propose_table

formula.description: Optional deterministic formula referring to column IDs.

items.description: Exact item version ID from retrieved evidence.

meaning.description: actual, estimate, plan, commitment, rule or assumption. Use plan for a new planning table.

items.description: Column IDs mapped to values; decimals are strings. Never invent missing facts.

function.description: List ZIP file members without extracting them. Requires an existing archive source ID.
function.name: archive_members

function.description: Include selected ZIP files only when the user explicitly asks to unpack them. Preserves the original archive and member lineage, with resumable retry. Never automatically recurse into archives.
function.name: include_archive_members

items.description: Exact member path returned by archive_members.

function.description: Search business evidence and older messages in this conversation. Business hits use itemID; conversation.hits use id and require history_read before citation. Business filters/pagination search only business evidence. No match is not proof of absence.
function.name: search

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, for the same query.

kind.description: Optional domain kind such as document, note, row, movement. Not actual/estimate.

meaning.description: Optional actual, estimate, plan, commitment, rule or assumption.

function.description: Discover saved mentions one hop from an exact business item. Incoming finds documents mentioning it; outgoing finds its destinations. At most 12 results per page. These labels and titles do not authorize citations: read each exact original before citing. Mentions are not business relationships or derivation. No external workbook or conversation access is granted. Empty results do not prove absence.
function.name: references

contentScope.description: Default all: saved body plus retained extracted-text mentions.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the same anchor, direction, scopes and filters.

direction.description: Default outgoing. Use incoming for where an item is mentioned.

historicalOrigins.description: Incoming: include earlier origin versions only when needed; default false.

id.description: Exact item version ID from visible workbook evidence.

kind.description: Optional exact domain kind; excludes requests and technical annotations.

meaning.description: Optional actual, estimate, plan, commitment, rule or assumption.

targetScope.description: Incoming scope: logical by default; exact restricts target versions.

function.description: Use when the requested answer needs a count of classified Source/Record entries matching metadata filters. This counts entries, not inventory units, facts inside documents or real-world events. It is not needed to verify a balance, validate citations or finish an ordinary answer. Put the receiptID in finish.counts for the exact scoped count.
function.name: count_records

kind.description: Optional exact domain kind, such as movement. Omit to include every kind.

meaning.description: Optional exact meaning; omit to include every meaning.

scenario.description: Optional exact scenario; omit to include every scenario.

status.description: Optional exact status; omit to include every status.

function.description: Read exact evidence, bounded text chunks and canonical saved references. Follow references.hits for saved destinations: a corrected binding can differ from the original raw URI. Destination metadata is discovery only; read it before citing. Use references for additional pages. Request Sources outside this run require scoped history_read, not item reading.
function.name: read

chunkLimit.description: Read one to eight chunks, default two. Follow chunkPage.nextOffset for the rest; a partial page is not the whole document.

copyOffset.description: Original-passage candidate offset from documentCopies.nextOffset. Keep the same chunk offset and limit while paging these candidates.

id.description: Exact item version ID returned by search.

offset.description: Chunk offset from chunkPage.nextOffset, initially zero.

function.description: Trace the evidence and derived records around an item.
function.name: lineage

function.description: List workbook tables with IDs, columns and row counts.
function.name: datasets

function.description: Read up to 100 table rows with deterministic formula results.
function.name: rows

datasetID.description: The table ID returned by datasets. Do not use an item/row ID.

function.description: Compare table values deterministically: minimum, maximum, difference and percentage cheaper relative to the maximum. Use for supplier cost comparisons instead of mental arithmetic.
function.name: compare_rows

valueColumn.description: Numeric or calculated column to compare.

function.description: Discover current drafts across this workbook, oldest first, 20 per page. Excludes requests and table rows; changes to rows appear as table proposals. Returns titles and exact IDs, not source bodies. Read originals before business claims. Pass only its nextCursor to continue.
function.name: review_queue

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous review page.

function.description: Open Drafts to review in the live workbook window when the user asks to see pending work or drafts. Does not accept, withdraw or change anything. The host confirms opening. Do not use for conceptual explanations.
function.name: open_reviews

function.description: Open an existing space in the live workbook window when requested. Supply its exact name or ID; use the visible active space ID for 'this space'. Ask when ambiguous. The host confirms whether navigation actually occurred. Do not use for explanations or to create a view.
function.name: open_space

target.description: Exact space name or ID; Home opens the workbook home.

function.description: Pin or unpin a navigation shortcut to an existing space. Does not copy the view, freeze values or create a snapshot. Use the visible active space ID for 'this space'. Use only when requested; ask when ambiguous.
function.name: set_space_pinned

pinned.description: True to pin the shortcut, false to unpin.

function.description: Create a named fixed snapshot of an existing space with exact values and input versions, only when the user requests a snapshot or frozen copy. For a pinned navigation shortcut use set_space_pinned. Limit 1,000 rows per table.
function.name: pin_space

function.description: Propose changed cells for human review. Read rows first, then supply exact row version IDs and only fields to change. Does not alter accepted values until the user accepts the visible proposal.
function.name: propose_table_edit

values.description: Changed column IDs mapped to new values. Decimal values are strings.

function.description: Deterministic decimal arithmetic. Use for arithmetic claims.
function.name: calculate

expression.description: Arithmetic expression, SUM, MIN, MAX, AVERAGE, COUNT, IF or ROUND.

function.description: Calculate accepted actual stock from an opening basis and unique events.
function.name: balance

subject.description: Exact inventory subject, such as brass bolts.

function.description: List saved native spaces.
function.name: spaces

function.description: Inspect bounded saved layout versions. Does not restore or alter data.
function.name: space_history

beforeVersion.description: Exclusive earlier version for paging; omit initially.

function.description: Edit an existing space or Home when requested. Read spaces for exact IDs/version. Preserve unrelated components. Stale bases refuse. Changes layout only. Move/insert requires at:first, at:last, or beforeID; omit unrelated fields.
function.name: edit_space

beforeID.description: Move/insert before this ID in the same group, instead of at.

componentID.description: Existing stable component ID for all operations except rename or insert.

text.description: New content for a text component only.

title.description: New space title for rename or component label for title.

function.description: Restore a saved layout as a new version only when explicitly requested. Inspect space_history and the current space first. Keeps prior history and business data; stale bases refuse.
function.name: restore_space

function.description: Create a NEW native space. To change Home or an existing space, read spaces and use edit_space instead. Every table AND every chart requires its own datasetID. Call this before claiming creation succeeded.
function.name: save_space

function.description: Save a draft document. For exact source labels, quantities or wording, use parts with copy IDs from documentCopies instead of retyping those passages. Combine copies with new prose. Use plain text only for a wholly new summary or paraphrase. A saved draft does not establish content completeness.
function.name: draft

items.description: Exact item version ID from retrieved evidence.

parts.description: Use parts OR text. Each part has exactly one field: text for new prose, or copy for an exact original passage ID. The host inserts copied text without regeneration.

copy.description: Exact passage ID from documentCopies.entries. The host supplies its original text and lineage.

text.description: New prose, headings or separators. Do not retype a passage requested verbatim.

function.description: Propose a draft interpretation. It does not accept a business event.
function.name: propose_record

items.description: Exact item version ID from retrieved evidence.

kind.description: Domain kind, such as forecast or analysis.

meaning.description: actual, estimate, plan, commitment, assumption or rule.

function.description: Propose a draft inventory movement only when evidence or the current request establishes direction relative to our stock. A receipt, delivery or handover alone does not establish who sent or received it: ask first. User acceptance is required to apply it.
function.name: propose_movement

meaning.description: actual for observed facts; estimate or plan for future scenarios.

occurrence.description: Business occurrence ID; reusing it cannot duplicate its effect.

quantity.description: Signed decimal: positive adds to our stock; negative leaves our stock.

supersedes.description: For a requested correction, exact current movement version ID. Keep its subject and occurrence; never invent a new occurrence to bypass a duplicate refusal.

function.description: Deliver the final answer and declare its basis. Business facts about Sources/Records or earlier messages require basis=evidence and inspected citations, even if a summary or host state suggests the answer. Explain missing/partial evidence and unsuccessful actions.
function.name: finish

answer.description: Plain-language answer. Do not print opaque IDs in prose.

basis.description: evidence: workbook/history facts, requires inspected citations. current_request: only information supplied in this request or arithmetic calculated from it. completed_action: only confirm a successful action in this run. general: guidance, greeting, clarification or verified interface labels; no business or earlier-conversation facts. unresolved: explicitly cannot establish the requested facts; no guessed answer.

items.description: Inspected item version ID, or message:ID returned by history_read for a statement about earlier conversation.

Optional current-run count_records receipt ID, only for entry counts needed by the requested answer. Omit for inventory quantities, calculations and ordinary cited answers. The host renders the exact count and scope. No search or historical receipt IDs.
